task:
Open the file /home/user/Documents/sales_data.xlsx in LibreOffice Calc. It contains a sheet called 'Sales' with columns: Product (A), Region (B), Q1 (C), Q2 (D), Q3 (E), Q4 (F). Row 1 has headers, rows 2-13 have 12 products.

1. Create a new sheet called 'Summary'.
2. In cell A1 of the Summary sheet, enter 'Total Revenue'.
3. In cell B1 of the Summary sheet, enter the formula =SUM(Sales.C2:F13) to sum all quarterly revenue.
4. In cell A2 of the Summary sheet, enter 'Average Per Quarter'.
5. In cell B2 of the Summary sheet, enter the formula =B1/4.
6. Make cells A1 and A2 in the Summary sheet bold.
7. Save the file .
